architecture.decision: Add one internal, read-only description projection beside the radar formatter that recognizes the complete bounded generated trailer, including the existing emitted format. Route every semantic description read through that projection, preserving the full stored description and producer behavior. Use deterministic fixtures at the producer transport boundary to exercise real enrichment and capture optional model inputs. Correct health assertions using project-relative path components.
architecture.rollback: Use a subsequent scoped corrective change through protected delivery. Preserve stored descriptions, operational records, receipts and historical attempts; require no data migration or destructive rollback.

nonGoals: Disable ticket-radar or remove advisory output.
Change semantic thresholds, scheduling, execution authority, ticket schemas or dependencies.
Modify the health analyzer, governance policy, fixture ownership or runtime deployment.
Create a competing writer, reset historical attempts, bypass admission or weaken blockers.
Create another repository, introduce external coordination, obtain new credentials or perform destructive cleanup.
delivery.outcome: Deliver semcod/planfile#293 within six application files: preserve enriched tracker descriptions, restore producer-independent semantic behavior, correct health-test path assertions, and verify through existing native OneDev and protected Validator publication.

Existing persistence, journal, tracker, scalar-validation, transport-failure, timeout, bulk-budget and authority checks pass with advisory bounds preserved.
